title: Project goal lifecycle core
description: Objective: implement pure immutable Project and Goal lifecycle reducers over the runtime contracts. Deliverable: packages/core project and goal modules with typed commands, events, results, and property tests. NOT in scope: planning graphs, leases, budgets, persistence, providers, or UI. Hard dependency: Runtime contract registry. Owned paths: packages/core/src/project/** and packages/core/src/goal/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Only design-authorized lifecycle transitions are reachable and every rejection has a stable code.
Expected-version and idempotency inputs are represented; stale mutations produce zero state change.
Reducers are deterministic, side-effect free, and return deeply immutable results.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
